the preparation of Al2O3 and TiO2-based photocatalytic composite materials and their application for the degradation of memantine, a micropollutants in the aquatic environment.
the preparation of a new type of 3D photocatalyst, Al2O3–TiO2 foam composite, which is suitable for the photodegradation of pharmaceuticals in aqueous solutions.

Al2O3 foams with high surface areas can be prepared by the replica technique, followed by sintering and sol-gel deposition of TiO2 film, which can be used for the photodegradation of pharmaceutical compounds.
